exposure: Multicomponent safe surgery intervention (training of inter-professional surgical teams, promoting use of the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, and introducing an infection prevention bundle)
outcome: Adherence to safety practices (WHO Surgical Safety Checklist utilization)
Surgical site infection (SSI) rates following cesarean section
cohort: 279 women in Tanzania who underwent cesarean section
finding: The study found that the multicomponent safe surgery intervention led to improved utilization of the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, reduced SSIs, and a drop in cesarean section-related perioperative mortality.
